verdict.rationale: GSA's open.gsa.gov pages publish concrete endpoints, including the Entity v4 URL with an api_key parameter, plus the Opportunities, Exclusions, Contracts, Federal Hierarchy and Assistance Listings APIs. They also document the key-issuance path: a 'Public API Key' from the SAM.gov account details page, or approved System Accounts. The Entity API page has a dedicated 'API Key Rate Limits' section. Missing for 10: the actual rate-limit figures are not quoted in the evidence (only the section's existence is), and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of key issuance or endpoint behavior.
